evidence.notes: The provisional nominal footprint is symmetric at 0.30 m. The longitudinal body-height filter margin remains 0.05 m because the stationary corridor and open comparison retain central front/rear self returns near the nominal edge. The lateral filter margin is 0.0 m: a 2026-06-14 paired capture showed 245-345 points per frame in the right 0.30-0.35 m band with the equipment case present and zero points in that band across 12 open-scene frames after moving forward about 0.5 m. Those points were external case/cable returns, not robot self returns. Low hazards outside the nominal footprint remain visible. Reported clearance remains referenced to the nominal 0.30 m body edge. This estimate remains pending until five stationary scenes are accepted.
